title: C021 NotebookLM / Gemini notebooks / Drive / MCP capability matrix

paths.name: Official consumer NotebookLM / Gemini Notebook API
paths.auth: none documented; personal Google Account in the UI
paths.notes: No public consumer write API identified in reviewed first-party docs on 2026-09-12; bounded research, not proof of private interface absence.

paths.name: Gemini Notebook Enterprise Discovery Engine API
paths.auth: gcloud access token on a GCP project with Enterprise license
paths.notes: Official, but a different product. Source replace is delete+create; no documented freshness/sync. Adopting it is a SKU/GCP decision, not the C021 default.

paths.name: Gemini Notebooks bidirectional UI sync
paths.auth: same Google Account in the Gemini and NotebookLM UIs
evidence: Google AI Ultra/Pro/Plus bidirectional sync rolled out April 2026 (web)
Sources, chats-in-notebook, and custom instructions sync; Studio outputs do not
paths.notes: UI-only hybrid workflow. Creating in Gemini can mirror a notebook to NotebookLM, but there is no programmatic create/add/replace/freshness API. Not an automation path.

paths.name: Google Drive/Docs indirection
paths.product: consumer NotebookLM Drive sources + optional git-to-Drive staging
paths.auth: Google Account that owns both Drive files and the notebook
evidence: Enterprise Drive sources exist, but consumer freshness is the reverse-engineered RPC
paths.notes: Best native freshness for Drive-linked Docs/Slides/Gemini Notes. Does not create/list/delete notebooks by itself. Markdown from git is not Drive-native; a git-to-Drive uploader would be extra, unbuilt work. Pasted text and URL sources cannot be freshness-synced. Current consumer help describes automatic Drive source updates; no live MCP freshness canary performed.

paths.name: Existing C021 MCP + doc-refresh (reuse)
evidence: WOR-184 reuse verdict, merged PR #4 at 3681e88
server.py 31 tools including notebook_create/list/delete and notebook_add_text/url/drive
Last live MCP attempt 2026-01-03 failed (wrong cached session)
paths.notes: Preferred automation path for consumer NotebookLM. Source-complete write surface. Live auth and uploads are not proven in this sandbox. Replace for pasted text is add-new-then-delete-old, not an in-place RPC. Freshness RPC covers Drive/Gemini Notes only. Destructive tools require confirm=True.

paths.name: Browser / UI automation last resort
evidence: Guardrail: only after two failed MCP auth refresh attempts
paths.notes: Fragile click-path prototype. Explicit last resort. Not a nightly runner. Coordinate clicks, dialogs, and rate limits all fail independently.
